name: Armada Caller (Armorist Archetype)
body:
Armada callers rely on a wide variety of mechs which they can call upon in any given situation, piloting an endless body of specialized machines.

Summon Mech

When the armada caller uses summon equipment, she may summon a bonded mech* of a pilot level equal to her class level in place of a weapon or suit of armor. The armada caller may choose to enter and pilot the mech as part of the action to summon it, and may select the mech’s body type and enhancements as part of the action to summon it. Any mech that the armada caller summons gains an enhancement bonus as a summoned piece of armor. A summoned mech lasts for the same duration as a piece of summoned equipment.

For every additional spell point the armada caller spends while summoning a mech, she may fill one of the mech’s weapon slots with a summoned weapon. Whenever the armada caller summons a weapon, she may immediately slot that weapon into her mech. The armada caller may slot weapons in their possession into a summoned mech as part of the action to summon it.

This alters summon equipment and replaces bound equipment.
